# Resource: tfe_stack_variable_set

Manages associations between variable sets and stacks.

## Example Usage

```csharp
using Constructs;
using HashiCorp.Cdktf;
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
using Gen.Providers.Tfe;
class MyConvertedCode : TerraformStack
{
    public MyConvertedCode(Construct scope, string name) : base(scope, name)
    {
        var tfeOrganizationTest = new Organization.Organization(this, "test", new OrganizationConfig {
            Email = "admin@company.com",
            Name = "my-org-name"
        });
        var tfeStackTest = new Stack.Stack(this, "test_1", new StackConfig {
            Name = "my-stack-name",
            ProjectId = Token.AsString(tfeOrganizationTest.DefaultProjectId)
        });
        /*This allows the Terraform resource name to match the original name. You can remove the call if you don't need them to match.*/
        tfeStackTest.OverrideLogicalId("test");
        var tfeVariableSetTest = new VariableSet.VariableSet(this, "test_2", new VariableSetConfig {
            Description = "Some description.",
            Name = "Test Varset",
            Organization = Token.AsString(tfeOrganizationTest.Id)
        });
        /*This allows the Terraform resource name to match the original name. You can remove the call if you don't need them to match.*/
        tfeVariableSetTest.OverrideLogicalId("test");
        var tfeStackVariableSetTest = new StackVariableSet.StackVariableSet(this, "test_3", new StackVariableSetConfig {
            StackId = Token.AsString(tfeStackTest.Id),
            VariableSetId = Token.AsString(tfeVariableSetTest.Id)
        });
        /*This allows the Terraform resource name to match the original name. You can remove the call if you don't need them to match.*/
        tfeStackVariableSetTest.OverrideLogicalId("test");
    }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `StackId` (String) The ID of the stack to which to add the variable set.
- `VariableSetId` (String) The ID of the variable set to add to the stack.

### Read-Only

- `Id` (String) The ID of the stack variable set association in the format `Stack/varset`.



## Import

Resource tfe_stack_variable_set can be imported in the following format: 

```shell
# via <STACK ID>/<VARSET ID>
terraform import tfe_stack_variable_set.test st-abcdefgh/varset-ijklmnop
```
